[Only the envelope seems to survive of this letter; it is postmarked Winchester 26 March 1853 and Plympton 27 March 1853, endorsed ‘Coleridge’ with writing inside the flap ‘Your letter is come, many thanks, We went to see about the ?cousingas [another inserted illegible word] the woman was out but is to call.

The Herb is soon to be begun.’ It perhaps refers to the publication of [The Herb of the Field](/book/17) (1853)]
